description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who rated various criteria, labeled along the vertical axis from top to bottom as “Relevant FCs,” “FC Summary,” “Relevance Explanation,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation.” The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” ranges from 0 to 6 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each bar corresponds to a criterion and its length indicates the number of participants who selected it, with exact values labeled at the end of each bar. The top bar, “Relevant FCs,” is dark purple and extends to 6 participants. The second bar, “FC Summary,” is dark blue and extends to 5 participants. The third bar, “Relevance Explanation,” is teal and extends to 3 participants. The fourth bar, “Clarity and Simplicity,” is also teal and extends to 3 participants. The fifth bar, “Overall Summary,” is green and extends to 2 participants. The sixth bar, “Filters,” is a lighter green and extends to 1 participant. The bottom bar, “Veracity Explanation,” is olive green and also extends to 1 participant. The bars are arranged in descending order of participant count, starting with the highest value at the top. There are no visual distinctions such as shading, bolding, or outlines to emphasize any particular bar.
